notes: Bare mass-noun subject with a copular predicate correctly lands on kind-level Inheritance, and the two premodifiers are split the way the adjective+noun rule prescribes -- 'crystalline' fused into a kind with both genus and modifier decomposition, colour-like 'pale' left as its own separate property rather than fused. The definitional 1.0/0.99 on sb_pale is the one arguable point (a colour property of a kind is the prompt's own paradigm empirical case, 'all swans are white' at 0.9), but reading the whole predicate as the definiens of a defined substance makes 0.99 defensible.
